einzeiler: The cast of The Sandlot reunites to discuss their new series Dugout Dads.
kurzfassung: The cast of the classic film The Sandlot reunites on a podcast to discuss their new series Dugout Dads. They share behind-the-scenes stories from the original movie, reflect on fan interactions, and talk about growing up as child actors. The interviews also cover personal projects, charity work, and the enduring legacy of their time on screen.
stichpunkte: The Sandlot cast reunites for a new comedy series titled Dugout Dads.
Patrick Renna discusses how a viral street encounter launched his social media career.
The actors recall the intense and rigorous casting process for The Sandlot.
Cast members share memories of working with James Earl Jones on set.
Marty York discusses his documentary Beyond the Lot and his journey of resilience.
Grant Gelt highlights the youth sports nonprofit playforever.org.
The cast discusses why Dugout Dads is a spiritual expansion rather than a direct sequel.

beschreibung:
Danielle and Patrick Renna are serving up s’mores and taking swings with the whole OG Sandlot gang, in celebration of their upcoming series, Dugout Dads!

It’s time to go ‘round the horn and catch up with Tom Guiry, Marty York, Grant Gelt, Victor Dimattia, Shane Obedzinski, Brandon Quintin Adams and Chauncey Leopardi.

Hear all their 1993 memories of filming a classic movie as kids, what it was like getting back on the field as adults and we find out who can REALLY play baseball - all on this action-packed Dugout Dads Takeover!
